verdict.reasoning: The 300 dpi render of page 116 (II-32) prints the bold heading '7.5 THE CONCEPT OF QUEUES', and the markdown has exactly that text: '## 7.5 THE CONCEPT OF QUEUES'. No heading is missing, so the kind 'missing-heading' is wrong. The only difference is the markdown heading level. That level is the same as the '## 7.4' heading on this page and the '## 7.3' heading before it. The markdown is uneven across the chapter (7.1 and 7.2 use ###, while 7.3 through 7.6 use ##), but that is formatting that the section number 7.5 already resolves. The wording, number and content all match, and nothing changes meaning. Under the task's rules, a formatting-only difference is rejected.
